english: How HandLine Company revolutionized worker safety at Harlow Glass, a scientific glass manufacturer in Essex, UK, with specialized heat-resistant gloves that improved both protection and compliance.
italian: Come HandLine Company ha rivoluzionato la sicurezza dei lavoratori presso Harlow Glass, un produttore di vetro scientifico nell'Essex, Regno Unito, con guanti termoresistenti specializzati che hanno migliorato sia la protezione che la conformità.
french: Comment HandLine Company a révolutionné la sécurité des travailleurs chez Harlow Glass, un fabricant de verre scientifique dans l'Essex, au Royaume-Uni, avec des gants spécialisés résistants à la chaleur qui ont amélioré à la fois la protection et la conformité.
spanish: Cómo HandLine Company revolucionó la seguridad de los trabajadores en Harlow Glass, un fabricante de vidrio científico en Essex, Reino Unido, con guantes especializados resistentes al calor que mejoraron tanto la protección como el cumplimiento.

english:
Harlow Glass, a premier manufacturer of scientific glass products in Harlow, Essex, has been at the forefront of specialized glass production for laboratories and research facilities across the UK. Their production processes involve extensive hot glass molding and handling of materials at extreme temperatures, creating significant safety challenges for their workforce.

Before partnering with HandLine Company, Harlow Glass faced recurring safety issues in their manufacturing facility. Workers were reluctant to consistently wear their previous heat-resistant gloves due to discomfort and limited dexterity, leading to occasional burns and near-miss incidents. Management was concerned about both the immediate safety risks and potential long-term regulatory compliance issues.

HandLine Company performed a comprehensive assessment of Harlow Glass's production environment, focusing on specific temperature thresholds, handling requirements, and worker movement patterns. Our technical team recommended our ThermaFlex 350 gloves, which provide protection up to 350°C while maintaining exceptional flexibility.

The implementation phase included personalized fitting sessions for all production staff and tailored training on proper glove usage and maintenance. HandLine's specialists remained on-site during the initial weeks to gather feedback and make adjustments where necessary.

The results have been transformative. Since implementing HandLine's glove solutions, Harlow Glass has reported zero heat-related hand injuries, a 95% increase in glove compliance among workers, and significant improvements in production efficiency due to reduced work stoppages. Most importantly, workers now proactively request our gloves, citing the unprecedented combination of protection and comfort.
